content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hi, I hope you are having a good week. I am looking forward to getting started on this project and have reviewed the agreement. Could we make a few adjustments before signing?

- Regarding the intellectual property transfer, the current wording assigns the rights immediately upon creation rather than upon full payment. I propose updating this so that the rights transfer to the client only upon receipt of full payment.
- Similarly, the clause defining the deliverables as works-made-for-hire transfers ownership before payment is guaranteed. I suggest modifying this to state that ownership remains with the contractor until all fees due under the agreement are paid.
- Concerning liability, the current terms exclude indemnification obligations from the limitation of liability, which could expose me to uncapped financial risks. I suggest updating this so that total aggregate liability for both parties is limited to the total fees paid or payable under the agreement.

Thank you for your understanding, and I look forward to moving forward once these points are addressed.

Best regards
